title: 第5章 银杏树
content_zh:
第5章银杏树
确定人影远去后，夜惊堂收刀归鞘，脸色化为了凝重。
先不论‘红财神’是敌是友，方才的一番交手，确实让他感觉到了压力。
以前在边关小镇，他是‘第一高手’，自认武艺放在江湖上，也算一流。
但见识过‘红财神’的枪法后，他才认识到自己和江湖名宿差距有多大——感觉就像是下棋，他每一步都想把棋盘砸穿，但真把棋盘砸穿了，也改变不了臭棋篓子的事实，无半分‘棋力’可言。
说简单点，就是他好像把力气用在了‘刀把’上，走错了方向。
夜惊堂对此并不奇怪，他武艺跟着义父学的，但义父根本没教真功夫，那就说明他学的都是‘假把式’，能学对才叫有问题。
这次来的是‘友’，下次杀上门的可不一定，没高深武艺傍身，肯定不是长久之计……
念及此处，夜惊堂抬起眼帘，望向了皇城的方向。
红财神说要教枪法，在没真学到手之前，不可能把这当成指望。
哪怕红财神真心想收他为徒，为防受制于人，也必须留点后手。
而这个‘后手、底牌’，目前看来只有义父说的《鸣龙图》了。
先不说长生不老、羽化登仙，江湖传言，九张《鸣龙图》，只要得手任何一张，都能超凡入圣，远超常人。
虽然《鸣龙图》埋在‘后宫’一颗银杏树下，很难拿到手。
但当今天子是个女人，女人就算有面首，也不大可能住在后宫，这样后宫必然人烟稀少……
就算面首住在后宫，后宫有很多美男，他这‘王母追着喂饭’的长相，进去浑水摸鱼好像也不难……
私闯皇城大内，显然不是一拍脑门就能决定的事情，不把情况门路摸清楚，很容易把自己玩成‘夜贵妃’。
夜惊堂凝望皇城方向良久后，暂无头绪，便把‘潜入后宫’的事放在了心底，回到屋里开始收拾瓦砾碎木。
刚收拾没多久，巷子里冒出马蹄声，老镖师杨朝和鸟鸟的声音传来：
“少东家？少东家？”

“叽叽叽……”
“我没事。”
夜惊堂拍了拍手，走出院子，看着驰援而来的镖师：
“刚来了个江湖人，随口聊了两句，已经走了，虚惊一场。”
十二名镖师，扫视破败不堪的巷子，都是皱眉，杨朝劝道：
“少东家，三娘人不错，给我们每个人都安排了住处，小六子住的都比你这敞亮。要不你还是回去吧，京城人生地不熟的……”
夜惊堂并不确定‘红财神’是否和裴家有关，稍作斟酌，摇头道：
“无妨，这里清净，住习惯就好。我在京城确实找不到门路，明天再去裴家拜访，求个差事。你们不用挂念，早点回去休息吧。”
众镖师听见这话，皆是松了口气，当即下马帮夜惊堂收拾起来……
同一片夜空下，皇城大内。
夜幕降临，华灯初上，宫灯在飞檐下随风摇曳，光线透过大树繁盛枝叶，在白石地砖上留下小扇般的叶片倒影。
数名身着彩衣的宫女，提着灯笼，在游廊间垂首静立。
已有千年之龄的‘银杏树’下，挂着一架秋千。
身着金红凤袍的少妇，双手抓住秋千绳，在夜色中来回摆荡，荡的很高，华美裙摆和红色绣鞋，在树下划出一道半月弧线。
夜色清幽、美人如画，却没有半点人声，致使本来唯美动人的场景，显出了‘庭院深深空几许’的孤寂。
宽阔而雅致的唯美庭院，看起来便如同一座精心编制的鸟笼。
而独自在秋千上摆动的少妇，就似那笼中金丝雀，试图凭借秋千，让自身跃过红墙金瓦，看上外面的世界一眼。
踏踏……
在秋千来回不知多少次后，一道脚步声，从廊道间响起，继而是宫女的恭敬见礼：
“拜见靖王。”

银杏树下的秋千慢慢停了下来，上面的凤裙女人，转过头，露出一张风姿卓绝的脸颊。
红唇杏眸、眉目如画，却带着几分久居深闺的幽怨。
瞧见靖王过来，凤裙女人并未下地迎接，继续摆动秋千，柔声询问：
“离人，你今天怎么有空到这儿来？”
“过来给太后请安。”
东方离人身着银丝蟒袍，看起来就好似一名风华绝代的俊气王爷，来到秋千之后，扶着太后娘娘的肩膀，轻柔推动：
“方才和圣上商议政事，圣上让我过来看看。这么晚了，太后不就寝，可是觉得宫中枯寂？要不要我安排人，送太后去玉潭山庄小住一段时间？”
“在宫里是一个人，出去同样是一个人，有何区别？”
“我和圣上也一样。”
“不一样。你和圣上有正事儿可做，只要想，天下何处都去得，也能挑选中意的男子~”
太后娘娘偏过头，看向东方离人：
“本宫能做什么？在宫里一待就是十年，后宫没妃子让本宫管，活着唯一的指望，就是数日子等着葬入皇陵……”
“一入深宫里，年年不见春。”
东方离人推着秋千，轻声安慰：
“帝王之家，自古以来便是如此。您虽然过的枯寂，但至少受圣上敬爱……”
太后娘娘稍显不悦：“本宫宁可不受圣上待见。先帝其他嫔妃，有儿子随儿子出去就藩，没儿子更好，守陵三年即可出宫，就本宫最苦，没儿子出不去，又不能改嫁……”
东方离人眼神无奈：“您是太后！‘后’是妻，嫔妃是妾。自古以来除了灭国，哪有太后改嫁的说法？”
太后娘娘沉默了下：“史上没有改嫁的太后，但不守妇道养‘面首’的太后，可数不胜数……”
东方离人觉得此言，是在向她这便宜女儿‘索要面首’，颇为大逆的在太后娘娘肩膀上拍了下：
“太后，你说的这是什么话？”

太后娘娘轻哼道：“在深宫都快憋疯了，随便说说也不行？本宫又没说自己要养面首……好在本宫不是你亲娘，只是宫里的摆件儿，若是圣上嫡母，不守礼法蓄养面首，你还不是只能睁一只眼闭一只眼……”
东方离人叹了一声：“罢了，我就当没听见。”
太后娘娘想了想又询问：
“你和圣上都没有枕边人，最近可有物色？有没有画像什么的，母后给你掌掌眼？”
东方离人倒是刚画了一副‘美男图’，但瞧太后娘娘思春心切的模样，不太好拿出来一起品鉴。
“圣上忙于政务，我被绿匪的事儿愁的焦头烂额，哪有心思考虑婚配之事……”
“你也不小了，有机会还是要早点考虑……”
闲谈片刻后，几粒冰凉雨珠，从银杏树的间隙落下。
沙沙沙……
太后娘娘抬起眼帘，看向银杏树郁郁葱葱的树冠，眼底中带上了三分怨意：
“都说此树有灵，本宫每天过来探望，结果可好，入宫十年没遇见一件好事儿，让本宫命苦就罢了，荡个秋千散心还下雨扫兴，过几天就把你砍了！”
“天公不作美下雨，树为太后遮风挡雨，若是太后砍了此树，岂不更加风雨无依？”
“也是……”
content_en:
Chapter 5 Ginkgo Tree
After confirming that the figure was gone, Ye Jingtang sheathed his sword and his expression turned solemn.
Regardless of whether the 'Red God of Wealth' is an enemy or a friend, the fight just now really made him feel the pressure.
In the past, he was the 'number one master' in the border town, and he considered his martial arts skills to be first-rate in the world.
But after seeing the marksmanship of the 'Red God of Wealth', he realized how big the gap was between himself and the celebrities in the world - it felt like playing chess. He wanted to smash through the chessboard with every move, but if he really smashed through the chessboard, it would not change the fact that the chess basket was dirty, and he had no 'chess ability' at all.
To put it simply, he seemed to have used his strength on the 'knife handle' and went in the wrong direction.
Ye Jingtang is not surprised by this. He learned martial arts from his adoptive father, but his adoptive father did not teach him real kung fu at all, which means that what he learned were all "fake moves". Only if he can learn them correctly is there a problem.
This time it’s a ‘friend’ who comes here. There’s no guarantee that he’ll be the one to kill you next time. If you don’t have high-level martial arts by your side, it’s definitely not a long-term solution...
Thinking of this, Ye Jingtang raised his eyes and looked in the direction of the imperial city.
The Red God of Wealth said he would teach marksmanship, but it was impossible to count on it until he actually learned it.
Even if the Red God of Wealth really wants to accept him as his disciple, he must have some backup plans to prevent him from being controlled by others.
As for this 'backhand, trump card', it seems that the only one currently available is the "Crying Dragon Picture" mentioned by my adoptive father.
Not to mention immortality and immortality, there are rumors in the world that if you get any one of the nine "Singing Dragon Pictures", you can become a saint, far beyond ordinary people.
Although "The Singing Dragon Picture" is buried under a ginkgo tree in the 'harem', it is difficult to get it.
But when today is a woman, even if a woman is decent, it is unlikely that she will live in the harem, so the harem will inevitably be sparsely populated...
Even if Mianshou lives in the harem, where there are many beauties, and with his 'Queen Mother chasing after her to feed her' appearance, it seems that it would not be difficult to fish in troubled waters...
Breaking into the imperial city privately is obviously not something that can be decided with a slap on the forehead. If you don't figure out the situation clearly, you can easily turn yourself into a 'night noble concubine'.
After Ye Jingtang stared at the direction of the imperial city for a long time, he had no clue, so he put the matter of 'sneaking into the harem' in his heart, returned to the house and started to collect the rubble and wood.
Not long after cleaning up, the sound of horse hooves could be heard in the alley, and the voices of old escort Yang Chao and Bird Bird could be heard:
"Shaodong's family? Shaodong's family?"
"Chi chi chi..."
"I'm fine."
Ye Jingtang clapped his hands, walked out of the yard, and looked at the escort who came for help:
"A man from the world just came here, chatted casually for a few words, and has already left. It was a false alarm."
The twelve bodyguards glanced at the dilapidated alley, all frowning. Yang Chao advised:
"Young master, Sanniang is a nice person. She has arranged a place for each of us. The place Xiaoliuzi lives in is more spacious than yours. Otherwise, you should go back. You are unfamiliar with the capital city..."
Ye Jingtang was not sure whether the 'Red God of Wealth' was related to the Pei family. After thinking about it for a while, he shook his head and said:
"It doesn't matter. It's clean here and you can get used to it. I really can't find a way in the capital. I'll visit the Pei family tomorrow to ask for a job. Don't worry about it. Go back and rest early."
When all the escorts heard this, they all breathed a sigh of relief and immediately dismounted to help Ye Jingtang pack up...
Under the same night sky, inside the imperial city.
As night falls, the lanterns are first lit, and the palace lanterns sway in the wind under the eaves. The light passes through the lush branches and leaves of the big trees, leaving small fan-like reflections of the leaves on the white stone floor tiles.
Several palace maids in colorful clothes, holding lanterns, stood in silence in the verandah with their heads bowed.
There is a swing hanging under the thousand-year-old Ginkgo tree.
A young woman in a golden and red phoenix robe grabbed the swing rope with both hands and swung back and forth in the night, swinging very high. Her gorgeous skirt and red embroidered shoes drew a half-moon arc under the tree.
The night is quiet, the beauty is picturesque, but there is no sound of people, which makes the originally beautiful and moving scene appear lonely and lonely.
wideThe elegant and beautiful courtyard looks like a carefully crafted birdcage.
The young woman swinging alone on the swing is like the canary in the cage, trying to use the swing to jump over the red wall and gold tiles and take a look at the outside world.
Tread...
After walking back and forth on the swing an unknown number of times, the sound of footsteps sounded from the corridor, followed by the respectful greeting of the palace maid:
"Meet Prince Jing."
The swing under the ginkgo tree slowly stopped, and the woman in the phoenix skirt on it turned her head, revealing a charming face.
Red lips, apricot eyes, and picturesque features, but with a hint of resentment as if she had been living in a boudoir for a long time.
Seeing Prince Jing coming, the woman in the phoenix skirt did not go down to greet him. She continued to swing on the swing and asked softly:
"Li Ren, why do you have time to come here today?"
"Come and pay your respects to the Queen Mother."
Dongfang Liren was dressed in a silver python robe and looked like an extremely handsome prince. After coming to the swing, he held the Queen Mother's shoulders and pushed gently:
"I was just discussing political affairs with Your Majesty, and Your Majesty asked me to come and take a look. It's so late, and the Queen Mother doesn't go to bed, but she feels that the palace is deserted? Do you want me to arrange for someone to send the Queen Mother to Yutan Villa to stay for a while?"
"You are alone in the palace, and you are alone when you go out. What's the difference?"
"The same goes for me and Your Majesty."
"It's different. You and the Holy One have business to do. As long as you think about it, you can go anywhere in the world and choose the man you like~"
The Queen Mother turned her head and looked at Dongfang Liren:
"What can I do? I have stayed in the palace for ten years. There are no concubines in the harem for me to take care of. My only hope for survival is to count the days and wait to be buried in the imperial mausoleum..."
"Once you enter the deep palace, you will never see spring every year."
Dongfang Liren pushed the swing and comforted softly:
"The emperor's home has been like this since ancient times. Although you have lived a lonely life, at least you are loved by the Holy One..."
The Empress Dowager was slightly displeased: "I would rather not be welcomed by the Holy One. The other concubines of the late emperor had sons who followed their sons and became feudal lords. It is better not to have sons. They can leave the palace after guarding the mausoleum for three years. I am the most miserable. Without sons, I can't leave, and I can't remarry..."
Dongfang Liren's eyes were helpless: "You are the Queen Mother! The 'Queen' is the wife, and the concubines are concubines. Since ancient times, except for destroying the country, how can there be any saying that the Queen Mother remarries?"
The Queen Mother was silent for a moment: "There has never been a Queen Mother who remarried in history, but there are countless Queen Mothers who did not follow the rules of women and raised their 'face'..."
Dongfang Liren felt that this statement was asking for respect from her cheap daughter, so she patted the Queen Mother on the shoulder rather rebelliously:
"Queen Mother, what are you talking about?"
The Empress Dowager hummed softly: "I'm almost going crazy in the deep palace, so I can't talk about it casually? I didn't say that I wanted to keep a good face... Fortunately, I'm not your biological mother, but just a decoration in the palace. If she was the aunt of the Holy Emperor and didn't follow the etiquette and keep a good face, you wouldn't have to turn a blind eye..."
Dongfang Liren sighed: "That's all, I'll just pretend I didn't hear it."
The Queen Mother thought for a while and asked again:
"Neither you nor the Holy One have anyone to sleep with. Have you found anyone recently? Is there a portrait or something that the Queen Mother can give you?"
Dongfang Liren had just painted a 'picture of a beautiful man', but seeing the Queen Mother's eagerness for love, it was not easy to take it out and appreciate it together.
"Your Majesty is busy with government affairs, and I am so worried about the green bandits that I have no time to think about marriage..."
"You are not young anymore. If you have the opportunity, you should consider it early..."
After chatting for a while, a few cold raindrops fell from the gaps between the ginkgo trees.
swish swish...
The Queen Mother raised her eyes and looked at the lush crown of the ginkgo tree, with a hint of resentment in her eyes:
"It is said that this tree has spirits. I come here to visit every day. The results are great. I haven't seen anything good in the ten years I have been in the palace. It's just a miserable life for me. If you hang out on the swing to relax and it rains, I will chop you down in a few days!"
"God doesn't do his best.The tree protected the Queen Mother from the wind and rain. If the Queen Mother cut down this tree, wouldn't she be even more helpless in the rain? "
"Too……"
